title: Visible-light-driven green hydrogen and hydrogen peroxide production using a 2D porous organic polymer engineered with 2D SnS2
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01138H, Paper
Mainak Sarkar, Pekham Chakrabortty, R. V. Singh, Mrinal R. Pai, Mahboob Alam, Sk. Manirul Islam, Ahmed Mohamed Tawfeek
A 2D–2D SnS₂@TAPA-BPDA heterojunction photocatalyst efficiently converts water into H₂ and H₂O₂ under visible light, achieving ∼30 times and ∼14 times higher yields than bare POP, offering a sustainable route for solar-to-chemical energy conversion.
